Method of Attack: Remote code execution via memory corruption in BLE stack allowing unauthenticated attacker to take full control
Backdoor exploiting over-the-air download (OAD) feature with preset password to push fraudulent firmware updates
Impacted Systems: Texas Instruments BLE chips CC2640 (non-R2), CC2650, CC2640R2
Cisco and Meraki access points including 1542 AP, 1815 AP, 4800 AP, MR33, MR30H, MR74, MR53E
Attack Vector: Sending specially crafted BLE advertising packets to vulnerable devices with BLE enabled
Exploitation requires attacker proximity and BLE scanning mode enabled
Indicators of Compromise: Firmware versions prior to Cisco Aironet 8.8.100 and Meraki MR 25.13
BLE-STACK versions 2.2.1 or earlier for CC2640 (non-R2) and CC2650, 1.0 or earlier for CC2640R2
